Project Executive Briefing

High-level synthesis of system architecture, findings, and model competition.

All 5 Stages Successfully Executed

System Highlights & Key Discoveries

  • ✔ Data Integrity Ensured: Ingested 1,067,371 rows and cleanly eliminated 290,784 noise records (returns, missing IDs, free items, non-product fees, and wholesale extremes) using a 7-rule pipeline.
  • ✔ Structural Anchor Discovered: While Regency Cakestand 3 Tier generated the top sales (£277.6k), GraphX PageRank revealed White Hanging Heart T-Light Holder as the true topological anchor product connecting the entire customer graph.
  • ✔ Giant Connected Component: 99.98% of the customer-product graph belongs to a single giant component partitioned into 8 cohesive product communities.
  • ✔ Recommender Complementarity: Association rules excel at immediate basket cross-sell (Precision@10 = 0.0651), while Implicit ALS solves catalog starvation by providing 40.24% catalog coverage.
